$comment: Shard definitions for the Stryker matrix in .github/workflows/test-quality.yml. Read by that workflow (`node -p`), never by Stryker itself, so it stays out of stryker.config.json (which warns on unknown keys). Mutant counts dominate, but per-file test-setup cost is real too, so shards that were still the long tail are split again to cut how many files each has to cycle through. Regenerate if src/lib changes materially.
